summary: Project involves a scoring/adjustment data table and chart; user reports the data table is incorrect and has specified the intended 13x11 table schema (row # plus 5 gross-score/deduction pairs).
architectural_notes: Expected table format: 13 rows x 11 columns = [Row #] + 5 pairs of [Gross Score, Holes to Deduct] representing adjustment columns.
known_issues: Data table is still not correct; needs to be rebuilt to match the user-provided 13x11 schema and values.

existing_features.title: Fix the chart table UI so placeholder cells (grossScore = 0 and worstHoles = 0) are displayed as blank/empty cells (not literal zeros) wherever the chart grid is shown/edited, while keeping the underlying stored value as 0 for those placeholders.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix the scoring data table to match the provided schema: 13 rows x 11 columns; Col 1 is row number; remaining columns are gross score and holes-to-deduct pairs for adjustments (Col 1 adjustment through Col 5 adjustment).

Ensure users who already have older shipped 18-hole defaults cached in localStorage automatically receive the updated shipped 18-hole defaults when appropriate. Specifically: if the stored active grid chart and/or stored user-default grid chart exactly matches the previously shipped 18-hole defaults, clear those localStorage entries so the new shipped defaults are used.

Align backend Callaway chart logic with the updated 18-hole chart behavior used by the frontend, using the same gross-to-deduction mapping (including 0.5 deductions) so backend net score outputs match frontend results for the same hole scores and course par.
